'''Hat Lo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
===Hutt errand boy===
Hat Lo, a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="WhosWho" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="Tas Kee" /> was an up-and-coming<ref name="Gamer 10">{{GamerCite|10|Galactic Power Brokers}}</ref> [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="CSWE" /> and [[spice lord]]<ref name="Elan">{{FactFile|66|SLE 1-2|Elan Sleazebaggano}}</ref> who had his own criminal empire. He operated from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] following the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|258|Lo, Hat}}</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="32 BBY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Known for his overblown opinion of himself, Lo encouraged the idea that he had a vast criminal network on Coruscant<ref name="Scrapbook">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Scrapbook]]''</ref> and believed he was the most powerful out of all the gangsters on Coruscant at the time. In reality, he was<ref name="CSWE" /> secretly<ref name="WhosWho" /> just a lackey<ref name="CSWE" /> and errand boy for wealthy and powerful [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] gangsters. The Hutts grew annoyed with Lo,<ref name="Tas Kee" /> and one Hutt in particular was very annoyed by reports of his bragging.<ref name="Scrapbook" /> The man kept a screen of protectors around whenever possible, however.<ref name="Tas Kee" /> The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Ayy Vida/Legends|Ayy Vida]] was, unwillingly,<ref name="Galactic Files">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=Ayy Vida|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/93283/cid/6569443/2013-Topps-Star-Wars-Galactic-Files-Series-2-417-Ayy-Vida}}</ref> a long working<ref name="Vida">{{DB|character|ayyvida|Vida, Ayy}}</ref> [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]]<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> consort for Lo. She would have fled from him, had it not been for her fear of [[Tas Kee]], Lo's enforcer.<ref name="Vida" /> 

===Outlander criminal===
During a cold and rainy [[Local day/Legends|night]] on Coruscant, Lo and his hangers-on walked into the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="FF44">{{FactFile|44|COR 21-22|Coruscant – Outlander Club}}</ref> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE2" /> managed by the [[Baath brothers/Legends|Baath brothers]]<ref name="CL" /> in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]],<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> after seeing the warm and welcoming glow of the neon lights and a hostess's smile. Either wittingly or unwittingly, his patronizing of the club brought with him many criminals.<ref name="FF44" /> Lo's [[Slythmonger/Legends|slythmongers]],<ref name="Elan" /> hustlers of pharmaceutical supplies,<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|elansleazebaggano|Sleazebaggano, Elan}}</ref> lurked at the club selling the deadly drugs [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]].<ref name="Elan" /> The medical student [[Elan Sel'Sabagno/Legends|Elan Sel'Sabagno]] sold medical supplies<ref name="Gamer 10" /> and equipment stolen from his university to the crime lord for credits that helped him with his student life. He then moved to stealing valuable drug supplies, before becoming one of Lo's slythmongers.<ref name="Elan" /> 

During a night<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref>  in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the criminal [[Magaloof/Legends|Magaloof]] stole an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] and presented it to an associate of Lo's, becoming a member of his gang.<ref name="Magaloof">{{DB|character|magaloof|Magaloof}}</ref> That same night,<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}}, as depicted in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Lo visited the Outlander Club when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] was being interrogated by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. He availed himself of the private bar of the Baath brothers and while he did so, Vida entertained clients of his near the club's bar.<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Shortly after the club visit, Lo traveled among refugees on<ref name="AotC" /> the ''[[Jendirian Valley/Legends|Jendirian Valley]]'', an [[AA-9 Coruscant freighter/Legends|AA-9 Coruscant freighter]],<ref name="JV">{{CSWECite|II|155|''Jendirian Valley''}}</ref> when it departed<ref name="AotC" /> [[Westport]] on Coruscant.<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> During the journey to the<ref name="AotC" /> planet<ref name="CL" /> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], he sat near Skywalker and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="AotC" />

==Personality and traits==
Lo had light skin, [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="WhosWho" />

==Equipment==
While at the Outlander Club<ref name="CL" /> and while on the ''Jendirian Valley'',<ref name="AotC" /> Lo wore a floor-length light blue [[Clothing/Legends|robe]] with a large collar that covered his mouth.<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Hat Lo first appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AotC" />
